description: Output of rag_validation Step 6 (_generate_final_report). Combines deterministic validity, mathematical validity, and JD weight pipeline Phase 13 validity into a single PASS/FAIL verdict. Verdict is PASS only when all three flags are true.

verdict.description: PASS when det_valid AND math_valid AND jd_weights_math_valid. FAIL otherwise.

deterministic_valid.description: True when no hallucination, mandatory-gap, or anomaly errors were raised in Step 3

jd_weights_math_valid.description: Cross-reference of JD Phase 13 mathematical_validation.is_valid. False propagates into final verdict and score_adjustment warning.

importance_weighted_mae.description: Importance-weighted MAE from Step 4. Used in PDF report and scoring trace.

rules_fired.description: Total number of rules that fired across all sections (R001–R005)
